purpose: Teach: 藁/便所/破片/咲かせ/襟/受かっ/刈り/恩返し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが藁葺き家屋に住まれた
lines.en: You know, dear, when my father was young, he lived in a house with a thatched straw roof.
lines.style: Slow, wistful opening, gaze drifting somewhere far. Low measured tone, a gentle pause before the memory lands.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、戦時下のしゃがみ式便所を経験されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, and you, Grandpa — when you were young you had to use those wartime squat toilets, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft agreeing hum to open. Warm, papery voice, slow pace, gently teasing lift on the tag question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが空襲で陶器の破片を集められた
lines.en: Dear, when he was young, my father gathered up shards of pottery after the air raids.
lines.style: Quieter now, the memory darkening his tone. Deliberate pace with a small held breath before the air raids.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、庭に薔薇を咲かせる事に拘られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, when you were young you were so particular about getting the roses to bloom in the garden, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Brightening, affectionate tease on the fussiness. Slow melodic delivery, a smile clearly audible in the tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「襟を正して挨拶しろ」と教えられた
lines.en: Dear, when I was young, my father taught me — straighten your collar and greet people properly.
lines.style: Firms up imitating the father's sternness on the quote, then softens back into fond reminiscence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、難関国家試験に受かった日を覚えてらっしゃるわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, you still remember the day you passed that fearsome national exam, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Proud warmth swelling gently. Unhurried, loving emphasis on the passing, a soft rise on the closing tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田んぼの稲を刈り取られた
lines.en: Dear, when he was young, my father cut the rice in the paddies with his own hands.
lines.style: Calm, rhythmic cadence, as if watching the field again. Unhurried, trailing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、恩師への恩返しに尽力されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, Grandpa — when you were young you worked so hard to repay your old teacher's kindness, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle closing warmth, dipping almost to a whisper on the kindness. Slow, settling, the tag like a pat on his hand.
